question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping's consolidated control over the Chinese Communist Party, the Central Military Commission, and security institutions underpins the 95.5% trader consensus that he will remain in power through the end of 2026. Earlier removal of formal term limits, combined with loyalist appointments and ongoing anti-corruption purges that have neutralized potential rivals, has eliminated standard succession pressures ahead of the 21st Party Congress. Recent activity on the 15th Five-Year Plan and defense modernization further signals continuity rather than transition. While the narrow window leaves room for low-probability shocks such as sudden health developments or elite realignments capable of forcing resignation or dismissal, no verifiable institutional challenges or public signals of instability have emerged to shift market pricing.
